description.narrative: IFC will support Arboreal S.A. (the Company) with a financing package of US$40 million for several key initiatives focused on enhancing value-add products and operational efficiency including: (i) installation of a thermally modified timber (TMT) production line, (ii) deployment of a biomass/briquette system for byproducts and sawdust, and (iii) general capital expenditures at the Tacuarembó plant. Additionally, the Project will refinance Arboreals existing debt. Arboreals current operations include a sawmill and mass timber production facility.

The Project is expected to create significant positive development effects by generating jobs and environmental benefits, driving economic growth through expanded mass timber production, increased value-added and export earnings, and supporting industrial innovation and sustainable construction practices. It will also advance climate mitigation by expanding sustainably sourced mass timber, which acts as a carbon sink and replaces carbon-intensive materials, supporting Uruguays low-carbon development goals and catalyzing sustainability in the housing sector.
